industries.quote: The European Central Bank introduced long-term refinancing operations (LTROs) to address the euro zone debt crisis. These operations involved lending money at very low interest rates to euro zone banks
industries.scope_quote: lending money at very low interest rates to euro zone banks
industries.mechanism: The ECB's LTROs provided low-interest loans to commercial banks across the euro zone, enabling them to purchase higher-yielding assets or lend more to businesses and consumers.
